title: Biome Query
description: Adds one item that lets you easily see what biome the block you are clicking on is in.
body:
Requires **Kotlin For Forge** 

Adds a single item that has the ability to check the biome of the block you are looking at.  The item can be crafted using 6 iron ingots, 2 purple dye on the top and bottom, and one piece of redstone. You can use the item by right-clicking on a block and it will tell you what biome that block is in. Useful for Skyblock packs where you have items that can change the biome or if you are making a farm that requires a certain biome. Also, feel free to use this mod in modpacks, use my code, etc.

No MCreator.
